title: Max Pair Sum in an Array
summary: Given an integer array, identify the highest sum of any two numbers where the largest digit in both numbers matches.
statement: Given an integer array, identify the highest sum of any two numbers where the largest digit in both numbers matches. If no such pair exists, return -1.
constraints: Choose two different array indices whose numbers have the same largest decimal digit.
Maximize the sum of the chosen values.
Return -1 when no qualifying pair exists.
hints: Group each value by its largest decimal digit.
For each digit retain the largest value seen so far.
Before updating a group, combine the current value with that saved maximum and update the answer.
Every valid pair is considered when its later endpoint arrives, and keeping only the largest earlier partner dominates all others.
editorial: Every valid pair is considered when its later endpoint arrives, and keeping only the largest earlier partner dominates all others.

tests.explanation: Their largest digits are two, three, and four, so no pair qualifies.
The two largest values with largest digit six are 3366 and 2536, totaling 5902.
